sin.name: skill-made-due-outside-the-skills-listeners
sin.description: A rule, a handler of another module or other code makes a skill due or loaded, or builds an AgentSkill, instead of the skills commands run from one of the skills module's listeners.
sin.rule: Make a skill due or loaded from a commit listener of the skills module, which runs RequireSkill, LoadSkill or ResetSkills; a rule only reads and refuses.
